audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text invents four ability names — "E-Devastation (Fire)", "Q-Severance (Ice)", "W-Countenance (Malice)" and "Card Master's short dash" — and wants.you[1] tells you to punish TF's dash cooldown "after he blinks in with Q". wants.you[3] and content mid put the fear on W.
audit.why: Hwei's real subspells are Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt and Molten Fissure (Q form), Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection and Stirring Lights (W form), and Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw (E form) — the crowd control, including the fear, is the E form and W is the shield form. Twisted Fate has no dash and no blink in his kit at all: Q is a 10000-range card throw, W is a 200-range empowered attack, E is a passive every fourth attack, and R is a 1.5-second teleport. Telling a player to punish a dash cooldown that does not exist is advice they cannot act on.
audit.corrected: Fabricated names removed, the fear returned to the E form, and the no-dash fact turned into the actual reason the matchup works — once the card is spent he can only walk backwards.

audit.corrected: Both replaced with the real flat-6s figure, plus Destiny at 170/140/110.

notes: FOUR FABRICATED NAMES IN ONE FIELD: spikes[0].text carried 'E-Devastation (Fire)', 'Q-Severance (Ice)', 'W-Countenance (Malice)' and 'Card Master's short dash'. None exist. Hwei's subspells are Devastating Fire / Severing Bolt / Molten Fissure (Q), Fleeting Current / Pool of Reflection / Stirring Lights (W), Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw (E). I rewrote the field around the E crowd-control form without naming a specific subspell, because Riot's text does not say which of the three is the fear and which is the root, and the rest of the page's 'EQ root / EE fear' shorthand is not something I could verify from the kit. TF HAS NO DASH: wants.you[1] instructed the reader to punish a dash cooldown that does not exist — Q is a 10000-range card throw, W a 200-range empowered attack, E a passive, R a 1.5s teleport. This was actionable-sounding advice for a mechanic that isn't in the game. PACKET FALSE POSITIVE: suspectNames flags 'Gold Card' in spikes[1] as a misspelling of Wild Cards; Gold Card is the correct Pick a Card selection and was left alone. CHART: six of seven sides realigned to the packet-backed content layer as one atomic group; no paired win[N] edits because win[N] already holds the correct token. RATINGS left untouched.
